entities.summary: Erik Albert Pettersson was a Swedish weightlifter. He won two bronze medals at international competitions: in the lightweight division at the 1909 European Championships, and in the middleweight category (−75 kg) at the 1920 Summer Olympics. Aged 35, he was the oldest weightlifting competitor at those games.
